Parameter Descriptions for Package

Source: R/params.R
params.Rd

Default parameter descriptions which may be overridden in individual functions.

Arguments

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

fit

A kb_fit object.

object

A kb_fit object.

x

A kb_fit object.

x_name

A string naming the data for error messages.

prior_only

A flag specifying whether to sample from the priors only, for prior predictive checks.

chains

A whole number of MCMC chains.

niters

A whole number of saved post-warmup draws per chain (minimum 2; number of warmup draws defaults to match).

nthin

A whole number of the thinning interval.

cores

A whole number of cores used to sample chains in parallel, or NULL to use getOption("mc.cores") if set or chains if not. Capped at the number of available cores.

seed

A whole number passed to rstan::sampling() to make the fit reproducible, or NULL (the default, which uses a random seed). A preceding set.seed() also makes the fit reproducible.

progress

A string, one of "bar" (the default, a console progress bar), "verbose" (rstan's per-iteration output and diagnostic warnings), or "none" (silent).

progress_dir

A string giving an existing directory in which to record progress for kb_progress(), or NULL (the default) to record none.

conf_level

A number greater than 0 and less than 1 giving the compatibility-interval level.

estimate

A function that reduces a numeric vector of posterior draws to a single estimate, such as median or mean.

sig_fig

A whole number of significant figures for summary output.

include_random_effects

A flag specifying whether to include the group-level random-effect terms in the output.

rhat

A number giving the maximum acceptable Rhat.

ess

A number giving the minimum acceptable bulk and tail effective sample size per chain.

max_perc_divergent

A number giving the maximum acceptable percentage of saved draws that ended in a divergent transition.

by

A character vector of grouping factors giving the rows of the grid. One of:

  • NULL: no grouping columns (the typical site and year).

  • "site": one row per fitted site.

  • "year": one row per fitted year.

  • c("site", "year"): one row per site-year.

new_levels

A string giving how uncertainty is estimated for a site or year not in the data used to fit the model, or when new_data has no site or year column. Sites and years in the model fit always use their own estimates. One of:

  • "average" (the default): the typical site or year. The site and year effects are set to 0, their mean, so the interval does not include among-site or among-year variation. Use it to describe an average site or year.

  • "sample": a new effect for each new site or year, drawn from the estimated variation among sites or among years (the random-effect standard deviation). The point estimate is equivalent, but the interval is wider since it also includes that variation. Use it to get realistic uncertainty about a particular site or year that the model has no information on. The interval varies slightly between calls; use set.seed() to reproduce it.

representative_site

A character vector of sites in the fit whose effects a new site adopts (averaged when several are named), or NULL (the default) to follow new_levels.

Details

A flag is a non-missing logical scalar.

A string is a non-missing character scalar.

Sampling

Chains run in parallel by default, one core per chain, capped at the cores available. cores sets the number of cores; when it is NULL, getOption("mc.cores") is used if set. Set cores = 1 (or options(mc.cores = 1)) where cores are shared or limited, or inside another parallel process.

The sampler runs with adapt_delta = 0.95 by default, which reduces divergences at the cost of slightly longer runtime. Override it, or set any other sampler control, by passing a control list through ..., for example control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99); only the entries supplied are changed. See the control argument of rstan::stan() for the full set of entries.

By default, each of 4 chains runs 1000 warmup iterations and then saves 1000 draws with no thinning, giving 4000 draws in total. These match the defaults of rstan::stan() and Stan's general recommendations.

Check convergence with kb_converged(), glance(), or summary().

Model

kb_model_describe() prints the fitted model, with its priors, in notation or as a written description. The Methods article describes each model and its assumptions.

Priors

Each entry is named after the parameter it sets, which kb_model_describe() prints with the model. A list passed to priors replaces the entries it names; the others keep their defaults. The prior family of each entry is fixed; only its arguments can be changed.

Site and year interaction

The site:year effect lets a site depart from the year-to-year pattern shared by all sites. It is separable from the site and year effects only when a site has data in more than one year and a year has more than one site; otherwise the fit warns. Estimates for the site-years in the data are then unaffected, but other predictions depend on the sd_site_year prior (see kb_sensitivity()).
